pages.title: Jirai Kei
pages.text:
Cute, black and pink, and dangerous when cornered.

- **Tier:** Diamond
- **Durability:** 900
- **Sword damage:** 7.5
- **Armor (full set):** 15

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: In the [Alloy Forge](entry://alloy_forge/alloy_forge), 1 diamond, 1 crying obsidian, and 2 gunpowder make 1 Heartbreak Ingot.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Gear:** a glass cannon. Diamond mining and more damage than diamond, but armor only about as strong as iron.
- **Desperation:** jirai kei weapons deal more damage the lower your health: up to 50%% more when you're almost out, and 25%% at half health.
- **Clingy:** blocking with the jirai kei shield while below a third of your health heals a heart, at most once a second.

pages.title: Landmine
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** The first hit that drops you below a third of your health sets off a burst of pink hearts. Every mob within 4 blocks takes 6 damage and is thrown back. It breaks no blocks, and it can go off again after 60 seconds.
